questions.question: You accidentally spill coffee on your colleague's new shirt while working together. What is the most appropriate response?
options: It's fine, don't worry about it.
I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to do that.
Why did you drink so fast?
Let me clean it up myself.
questions.answer: I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to do that.

questions.question: A friend asks you to join them for dinner tonight, but you already have plans. How should you respond?
options: That sounds great, I'd love to come.
I'm afraid I can't make it tonight.
Sure, why not?
I'll bring my own food.
questions.answer: I'm afraid I can't make it tonight.

questions.question: During a group discussion, someone makes a claim that you strongly disagree with. What is the most effective way to express your view?
options: You are completely wrong.
I think that's a bit of an overstatement.
That's not true at all.
I disagree with you.
questions.answer: I think that's a bit of an overstatement.

questions.question: Your manager asks you to take on an extra project that requires working late. How should you respond?
options: I will do it immediately.
I'm not sure if I can handle that.
That's a terrible idea.
Fine, I'll do it.
questions.answer: I'm not sure if I can handle that.

questions.question: You are at a formal networking event and someone introduces themselves. What is the most suitable response?
options: Hi, I'm John. Nice to meet you.
Hello, I'm Sarah. Pleased to meet you.
Hey, what's up?
Nice to see you.
questions.answer: Hello, I'm Sarah. Pleased to meet you.
